summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (Material Change Report) reporting a temporary illegal work stoppage and blockade by unionized workers at its Camino Rojo Mine in Mexico from June 1 to June 5, 2026. Operations halted and resumed after the blockade ended. The dispute involved a worker productivity bonus and profit-sharing entitlement. No financial terms, board recommendation, or structural changes are disclosed. The company reiterated its 2026 gold production guidance of 110,000–120,000 ounces. This is an operational disruption, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
